texto: Imagine waking up tomorrow... and something feels different. The room looks the same. But your mind... is not. Overnight, your IQ jumped to five hundred.
pantalla: Imagine waking up tomorrow... and something feels different. The room looks the same. But your mind... is not. Overnight, your IQ jumped to five hundred.

texto: To understand how crazy that is: the average IQ is one hundred. A score of one thirty is considered gifted. And Albert Einstein? He was never actually tested, but people estimate he was around one sixty.

texto: Five hundred isn't just high. It's so far off the scale that, statistically, no human in the entire history of our species should ever reach it.

texto: The first thing you notice are patterns. The steam rising from your coffee. The traffic outside your window. Everything is a puzzle... and you've already solved it.

texto: You finish a three hundred page book before your toast gets cold. You learn Spanish on the bus. By lunch, you speak five languages.

texto: But your new brain comes with a price. A normal brain is only about two percent of your body weight, yet it burns around twenty percent of your energy. Yours wants a lot more. You are always, always hungry.

texto: Talking to people gets strange. You know how their sentences will end before they even start them. To you, the whole world moves in slow motion.

texto: In class, the teacher asks a question. You answer it... and the next ten questions she hasn't even thought of yet.

texto: And slowly, you start to feel alone. It's hard to share a joke when nobody else can see why it's funny.

texto: So you look for a real challenge. In the year two thousand, mathematicians picked seven Millennium Prize Problems, with one million dollars for each solution. Only one has ever been solved. You solve the other six... in a weekend.

texto: That's when the black cars show up. Governments, tech giants, secret labs. Everyone wants the smartest person on Earth on their side.

texto: You choose to help everyone. New medicines. Clean energy. Cities that almost build themselves. In a few years, the world changes more than it did in the last century.

texto: Because a five hundred IQ can solve almost anything... except loneliness. Maybe the smartest move of all is to bring everyone else along.
